title.label: It looks pretty. Not sure I’ve ever struggled so much to schedule tasks before.

content.label:
Initially, I was pretty excited about this. But the more I work with it, the more time I spend trying to figure out how to get the interface to put tasks where I need them to be on the calendar. It’s a bit of a mystery to me how the designer wanted this to work or how it was supposed to be. But in any case, it takes me about 3 to 4 times as long to put a task on a schedule compared with using something like Apple’s calendar.

I’ll keep on fiddling with it and perhaps I can raise my review. But it is an odd interface and I kind of wish I hadn’t paid the subscription.

title.label: Great in theory absolutely a pain to use..

content.label: I’ve been using this app as a structured to do list to map out my day-to-day and with the icons, the UI, and how it maps that I think it doesn’t really really great job in the app in theory is very good however, it is the most frustrating app I have ever used. Every time I try to add something to my list, God forbid I take half a second to process what I want to write, and it automatically shifts into the continue and time schedule and thing and then I have to go back to pull the keyboard back up to type again. NOT ONLY THAT, but whoever programmed the screen behind when the keyboard overlays, I don’t know if I just have fat fingers but every time I try typing anything on the top row of my keyboard, it sends me into a completely new tab and then I have to do the same thing I described again. Thankfully, I live a pretty simple life. Otherwise it might actually take hours out of my day to plan a single day with this godforsaken terrible programming of this app. Please fix, you have a great app on your hands if it just worked and I don’t mean to nitpick, but I want this to work and it discourages me using it every single time I’m reminded when using.

This app is amazing! It is able to keep me super productive during the times where I am procrastinating my assignments and need to get things done. It is able to keep reminders to make sure I remember to go to the gym or simply go to an important event! This app is absolutely amazing, and I think it deserves the hype that it is getting.

This app is sooo good! It helps you stay organized, gives you a gentle reminder before, during, and after the task, has a menstrual tracker, and keeps your mental health in check. It doesn’t bombard you with ads and doesn’t have a lot of in-app purchases. It’s really good to remember what you need to do in a nice way. You can also customize the color of your schedule and personalize it. Overall, really great app 10/10 no flaws.

Something about being able to use AI to organize my tasks as blocks of time through the day (by just writing “starting at 11, task 1 30 mins, task 2 10 mins,” etc. and then see the day laid out is incredible.

Structured provides a cleanly designed, easy to use planner that lets you organize your life and keep track of what you want to do. However it is frustrating that simple features like recurring tasks are locked behind a membership. It would be better if there was an external format you could access and edit your tasks from: since you can only edit tasks in the app, you can be limited by the interface. I have tried the AI assistant, but it is crippled by the fact that a) I believe they are using an older model that does not work as well, but more importantly b) it can’t have a conversation with you, but it doesn’t know that, so if you ask for a large task, it only does a small part of it, and then asks you to prompt it which you can’t do. I think the AI has the potential to be very useful if this is fixed.

title.label: It’s great to keep you on task

content.label: I have bad attention issues and it’s easy for my day to pass without taking care of things that need done. They say you should only schedule the big things, but if I don’t schedule the little things too, they won’t get done. This app lets me make my own schedule that works for me and helps me stick to it. I’m not always perfect, but when I slip, this app really helps me get back on track without guilt for missing an item or even a day. I enjoy the Fabulous app to help create habits and love the journeys and coaching, but if I miss a single item I break my streak and that works against me. Structured doesn’t do that. It has a feature to replan missed items. I can trash them if I didn’t do them, complete them if I didn’t mark them off or replan them. This works well for me. It’s a guilt free to do app.
No snoozing for me

Downloading this app was probably one of the best decisions I've made to stay organized in a long time lol. The design is so fluid and it's so easy to use! Don't worry! If you're are dyslexic, there even is a setting to change the font so it's easier to read. YOU CAN EVEN MAKE THIS APP A WIDGET! I give this life-changing, super easy-to-use app a 5 stars! Go see why! 🩷
